profiles.warning_signals: low apex shred,missing crit damage reduction,missing crit chance reduction,repair not keeping up,high hull damage early,short survival
profiles.expectation_text: VGER Silent enemies should be judged around Apex Shred, Critical Damage Reduction, Critical Chance Reduction, Apex Barrier, and HHP/SHP repair sustain. Do not treat them like generic Chen/T'Laan PvE hostiles.

profiles.warning_signals: no burning pressure,repair not offsetting hull loss,hostile Apex Barrier spikes,short survival
profiles.expectation_text: VGER Hurak guidance focuses on Burning, HHP/SHP repair, and Apex Barrier survival. Avoid setups that appear to trigger massive hostile Apex Barrier.

profiles.warning_signals: low isolytic output,repair not keeping up,low Apex Barrier,short survival
profiles.expectation_text: VGER Gorn guidance focuses on Isolytic Damage, Apex Barrier, and HHP/SHP repair sustain.

profiles.warning_signals: slow kill speed,massive HHP damage,repair overwhelmed,banned Orion crew used
profiles.expectation_text: VGER Orion is a fast-kill and HHP survival check. Judge whether the crew kills quickly enough while surviving heavy HHP pressure.

profiles.warning_signals: no repair sustain,no shot delay,short survival
profiles.expectation_text: VGER Fighters guidance favors Excelsior setups with HHP/SHP repair and shot-delay support.

profiles.warning_signals: no activation officer,no hull breach or burning when expected,low crit rate,crew not matching attack role
profiles.expectation_text: Outpost and retaliation attacks should be evaluated by whether the chosen activation package is present: Hull Breach, Burning, Morale, officer ability activation, or crit-chance pressure.

rules.rule_text: VGER Silent enemies should not be judged as generic Chen/T'Laan PvE hostiles; prioritize Apex Shred, crit reduction, Apex Barrier, and repair sustain.
For Silent comparisons, include active tech and boosts such as Quantum Slipstream, Chaos Deflector, Agony Booth, Godsend, Cerritos Boost, and Excelsior Boost.
Hurak notes warn against officers that appear to trigger massive Apex Barrier on the hostile.
Orion guidance is a fast-kill and HHP survival check; do not compare it cleanly against longer sustain encounters without noting the difference.
Outpost crews should be selected by activation role: Hull Breach, Burning, Morale, officer ability activation, or critical chance pressure.

stat_sources.applies_to: VGER Challenge and other Apex Barrier encounters
stat_sources.rule_text: Apex Barrier is a defender-side damage reduction stat. In VGER comparisons, check both Apex Barrier and opposing Apex Shred before making crew conclusions.

stat_sources.applies_to: VGER Silent and other Apex Barrier encounters
stat_sources.rule_text: Apex Shred is the attacker-side counter pressure into Apex Barrier. Silent guidance calls it out as a key stat.
Silent guidance calls for Critical Damage Reduction and Critical Chance Reduction checks alongside Apex Shred and repair sustain.
VGER setups frequently call out HHP/SHP repair sustain; compare repair per round and net hull damage after repairs.
